# 周瀛 (Ying Zhou)

> 周瀛（Ying Zhou）是北京交通大学信息与通信工程博士，现任摩尔线程推理优化工程师，研究方向包括分布式网络、数据中心网络、联邦学习、AI 基础设施和大模型推理优化。

## Verified facts

- Ph.D. in Information and Communication Engineering, Beijing Jiaotong University, 2020.09-2026.06.
- B.E. in Software Engineering, China University of Petroleum (Beijing), 2016.09-2020.07.
- Inference Optimization Engineer at Moore Threads.
- Vice Minister of the Innovation and Employment Department in the 13th Beijing Guangxi Doctoral Students Association, 2023.
- Research areas: distributed networks, data center networks, federated learning, AI infrastructure, MoE communication, and LLM inference optimization.
- National First Prize team member, China Undergraduate Mathematical Contest in Modeling, 2018. The university reported 292 national first-prize teams and a 0.7% national first-prize rate.
- Three IETF Internet-Drafts, including one first-authored draft. All are expired and are not IETF standards or endorsements.
- One granted Chinese invention patent, CN113950143B, and two published invention patent applications, CN122093312A and CN122387460A.
